note.headline: Related-party SPA finalized: Systematic Industries to buy 100% of WBIPL for Rs21.5cr from a promoter-group seller -- confirms the 9-Sep-2026 flagged deal
thesisChain: Systematic Industries signs a Share Purchase Agreement on 19-Oct-2026 to acquire all 10,000 equity shares (100%) of Wire Brigade Industries Pvt Ltd (WBIPL) from Veritas Industries Pvt Ltd (VIPL) at Rs21,500/share, aggregating Rs21.5cr
VIPL and WBIPL are both Promoter Group entities, so this is a related-party transaction the company states will be executed at arm's length
Consideration is a mix of cash and share swap; post-completion WBIPL becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary

This is a FOLLOW-UP, not new information -- the same ~Rs21.5cr related-party acquisition (funded by an insider-heavy Rs33.94cr preferential issue) was already flagged at 'high' significance on 9-Sep-2026; today just fixes the exact SPA date and per-share price
note.insight: FILING STATUS LINE: this is a formal Regulation 30 exchange filing, and it is NOT new information in substance -- the Sep-9 note already flagged this as a related-party acquisition of a promoter-group asset (~Rs21.5cr) funded by an insider-heavy Rs33.94cr preferential issue, at 'high' significance. Today's filing is the FOLLOW-UP: Systematic Industries has now formally signed the Share Purchase Agreement (19-Oct-2026) to acquire 100% of Wire Brigade Industries Pvt Ltd from Veritas Industries Pvt Ltd for Rs21.5cr (Rs21,500/share x 10,000 shares), confirming WBIPL becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary. VIPL and WBIPL are both Promoter Group entities -- a related-party transaction the company asserts is at arm's length, which still merits governance scrutiny given no independent valuation is disclosed in this filing. No target financials (revenue/profit of WBIPL) are disclosed, so accretion/dilution cannot be assessed; watch for WBIPL's financials in the next consolidated results and for any independent valuation report filed under RPT disclosure norms.
